info.note: Reservations recommended; an older source lists evening-only hours

places.name: Cava Garambullo
places.area: Out of town · El Vergel de los Laureles
places.desc: Tiny natural-wine cava making unfiltered blends largely by hand; tastings by appointment.

info.address: Near km 3.5, Carretera a Dolores Hidalgo
info.note: By appointment only — book a tasting by email (natalia@vinograd.mx)

info.note: Book tour slots online. Restaurant Trasiego Thu–Sat 13:00–21:00, Sun 13:00–20:00

info.note: Sources differ slightly (one lists Sunday brunch from 10:00). Reservations suggested on weekends · Tel 415 154 7862

places.name: Santuario de Atotonilco
places.area: Out of town · Atotonilco, ~14 km north
places.desc: 18th-century pilgrimage church whose ceilings are covered in folk-baroque murals — 'Mexico's Sistine Chapel'. A UNESCO World Heritage site.

info.note: Free entry, donation welcome. Parts may close during mass and pilgrim retreats.
